text:
If you've got afternoon plans outside, today's the easy one to say yes to. It's sitting at 79 and partly cloudy at midday with light northwest wind, and the official call is sunny into the afternoon with a high near 82, nothing dramatic. Worth noting the American model is basically dry today while the European model wants a lot more showers and even a thunderstorm chance, so if you hear thunder rumble through this afternoon, don't be shocked, just don't plan around it either. The lake's in good shape for it, water's a comfortable 72, winds staying light out of the north under 10 knots, waves a foot or less, so it's a fine one for a swim or a paddle before things go quiet tonight under partly cloudy skies and a low near 64.

Saturday warms a touch more, high near 85, with south wind picking up on the lake into the 10 to 15 knot range, still boating weather but freshening as the day goes on.
